candidate_considered: A sequence of typed expressions uses learned operator arities to find argument scope without a separate clause-end word. In an expected name slot the same written form can be a literal name which is an operator elsewhere. Thus repeated whole forms need not have one global lexical role or arity, and an AAAsequence can be interpretable when its first use is an operator and its later uses are names.
